[spoiler=Spread of Anthrax, Ebola and the Sarkos Virus???][b][u]Frontier Conflicts of the New Balion Empire face extreme circumstances[/u][/b]

Despite international focus on the recent illegal attack on Empire Island by Gaesunian forces, a more pressing domestic issue that has gone on since the refounding of the Empire has taken a new shape. With the vast reaches of the Northwest Frontier, covering the far north and northern half of the mountain range that is close to the western edges of the Northern Provinces of the mainland, former subjects of the "old" Balion Empire have splintered into savage groups that continuous fight for power on the border regions of the Empire (and across Western Argos). Groups closer to the New Balion Empire have often launched raids and fought with border forces on the Empire's current official edges.

Recently, a new campaign launched by the rogue state of "Raffordshire" to the Empire's northern coast has consistently attacked Imperial Soldiers and Border Guards in the aforementioned frontier region. While the Empire is always able to fend off Raffordic attacks, the chaos that ensues always leaves the open border vulnerable for guerrillas and subversives of Raffordshire. Well, this vulnerability has been taken to its fullest worst case scenario.

Uncovered and announced by the intelligence agency, Royal International Matters Bureau (RIMB), the discovery of  biological labs deep in Raffordshire, has been unsettling. Led by Dr. Felton Shienbaum, it has purposely created diseases to disrupt and destroy not only the Empire, but also all over Erene. The various diseases include, Ebola, Anthrax and a new disease known as the Sarkos Virus which heavily affects those who have the DNA of Halpogroup-O as the mixture of heavy coughs, fever, difficulty to breathe and its deadly advancements will cause those of Kainzhouian ancestry to suffer the most. 

Already in a few border towns and ports, this disease has a deadly effect. So far a few handles have died with ebola, few more with anthrax and a lot more with the Sarkos virus as the 10 thousand strong Kainzhouian community at the border port town of Smugglers Bay has been struck hard with around 3 thousand infections. The news of this was slow to spread, especially due the poor timing of the findings since it coincided with the Gaesunian disruption to emergency and military communication to the systems shared by Empire Island and the Northwest Frontier. To make matters worse, due to the aforementioned communication attacks and the recent bombings on Empire Island, communication to Kainzhou is extremely slow if not impossible to utilise. 

This also meant that at Smugglers cove, proper checks were halted at the ports meaning that many ships, especially bound for Kainzhou were infiltrated and sabotaged with the diseases and when officials realised, it was already too late. It is suspected that these ships must have come in contact with other ships and a few have already docked at Kainzhouian ports, especially in Daesun. A few ships that were not caught up with the siege of Empire Island, were quickly dispatched to try to  hunt down and sink the ships affected.  Health officials tried to communicate with Kainzhouian nations but to little to no success. Growing desperate, the officials have asked the Governor of Empire Island, George Bain, to communicate to the besieging forces that this racist, deadly disease made by Rafforshire has probably made its way to Daesun and they need to act immediately. He communicates from his HQ at the telecommunications centre in Port Augustus via Civilian frequency;  We have an urgent message, for the sake of your peoples and Erene, YOU MUST LISTEN!. Just as he states that, communications immediately glitch out meaning only a partial part of the message is sent

While Ebola is quickly limited to a few villages and quickly suppressed, Anthrax is slowly spreading to various bordertowns and villages. The internal security agency, the Imperial Enforcement Corps (IEC) with cooperation with the military, local constabulary and others, have stopped non-essential traffic heading towards and out of affected areas. Anyone who is not authorised and vetted is to be stopped and sent back and if they are Raffodic, are to be shot immediately. Due to the severe nature of his horrific warcrime by Raffordshire, the Imperial Parliament debated on whether or not to suppress and annex rogue Balionic rump states, which eventually spread to the nobility and the Emperor himself. With the war over Empire Island already happening and this new major threat, the military budget is to be increased from £62 Billion to £75 Billion with an extra 120 thousand active military personnel and a boatload of military equipment. Plans to invade Raffordshire to the north (which borders Asociya), Waltria to the north west and the rebellious Balion Rebel State to the islands south-east of the Empire are currently being made.
